verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a hosted corporate banking and card platform reached through its cloud API, using OAuth client credentials and an interactive playground. Nothing in the evidence mentions a self-hostable, on-premises or open-source deployment of the core product. Self-hosting is a fair openness question for this kind of software, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
